conditional_on_gbv.definition: P(take rate >= 18.10 | printed 3Q26 GBV band) read from the SAME joint draws as the headline (datasets/c11_model_v2.py; c11_v2_by_gbv_band.csv): GBV = 0.75 x print-state (R01 nights N(9.67,1.70) x B02 ADR mixture) + 0.25 x Street/market route N(26,300, 850), rounded to $100M; revenue = 4,730 x (1 + c), c ~ N(1.04%, 0.5%) with rho 0.5 to the GBV z-score, revenue-light branch p 0.15 (c ~ N(0.3%, 0.4%)), guide miss p 0.03. Sum(mass x p_yes) = 0.778 = the model headline (A05-01). Conditionals quoted with floors/caps 0.005 / 0.995 (A05-14).
conditional_on_gbv.point_gbv_note: each row conditions on the joint draws whose printed ($100M-rounded) GBV equals the cell; rev-1 rows re-centred the GBV prior at each value and are superseded (A05-11)
